# libsodium / secret_key_auth_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `secret_key_auth_fuzzer` ([source](source/secret_key_auth_fuzzer.cc), unmodified) over libsodium (jedisct1/libsodium at 2c61b499).

Checks one property, a self-validation: crypto_auth (HMAC-SHA512-256) of the whole input under a deterministic-RNG key must pass crypto_auth_verify with the same key.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libsodium at commit 2c61b499.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- crypto_auth (HMAC-SHA512-256) of the whole input under a deterministic-RNG key must pass crypto_auth_verify with the same key ([lines 33-35](source/secret_key_auth_fuzzer.cc#L33-L35)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libsodium` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `secret_key_auth_fuzzer.plain` | 68,448 | `c2fc1a403928786cf5746fc9fe2c917e18bc64c5ccd6c05ebc9ad016cadac9ca` |
| ubsan | `secret_key_auth_fuzzer.ubsan` | 68,344 | `6e2144df60a695cd1e12de71bbaa5bdc8e812ea873b2c3a4131a7c1fd0c302c6` |
| asan | `secret_key_auth_fuzzer.asan` | 786,904 | `f3d7fab2d883fc61f556f1e77e9bff78853562807057fd531d997a50d6a7007a` |
| asan-ubsan | `secret_key_auth_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 786,200 | `f14474d9ad83ffb3cafe381cf3aa0846ca5365c947a0ac05048f215deba36978` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
